title: SREV-113 service entry resource lifetime

official_service_shape.description: Official Win32 service entry, dispatcher, handler, and status shape

official_resource_shape.description: Official critical section and event-log handle lifetime shape

source_change.description: WinMain SID cache cleanup and service event-log handle cleanup

runtime_matrix.description: Windows SCM, proxy, dispatcher failure, and event-log handle proof

contracts: WinMain owns process-wide initialization before the service dispatcher or proxy worker path
DriverAssist InitializeSidCache initializes a process-local critical section before service and proxy paths
every local return path from WinMain after SID cache initialization calls DriverAssist DestroySidCache
proxy command-line detection order and proxy worker dispatch targets are unchanged
StartServiceCtrlDispatcher remains the SCM boundary for the normal service path
failed StartServiceCtrlDispatcher preserves GetLastError after SID cache cleanup
InitializeEventLog owns the event-log handle opened by OpenEventLog
opened event-log handles are closed with CloseEventLog on service initialization failure and STOP SHUTDOWN cleanup
SCM status transitions accepted controls and proxy routing must not change
